notes.title: In game leaderboard now live - & patch notes
notes.content:
The global leaderboard is now live in game.

The leaderboard is automatically updated to reflect your best score.

Compete for a place in the top 20!


Patch notes - 22 July 2019

1.  The difficulty level of each different 'third night' scenario has been slightly reduced.

Thanks all!

notes.title: New score and upcoming features
notes.content:
Congratulations to BigBoiWork for posting the second highest score to date on the leaderboard.

Upcoming features:
1. The global leaderboard will be included in the game itself and automatically updated each time you beat your previous score.  The global leaderboard will be live.

Expect this update in the coming weeks. ːsteamhappyː


Thanks all!

HeroHead studios.

notes.title: Patch notes 11 June 2019
notes.content:
The following patches have been made:

1.  Reduced detection hit from mosquitoes on survival mode.
2.  Spiders wait 2 seconds after biting player before able to bite again (removes possible 'double hit' impact).

Thanks all.
